items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Mr. Willie Linesmith. I called him, I said, Mr. Lion or Mr. Mouse.

ctx.x: ¶¶ Mr. Willie Linesmith. I called him, I said, Mr. Lion or Mr. Mouse. Oh, you should read this letter. Did you send a copy?

Huh? Did you send a copy yourself? No, I mean, but I mean. Do you still have a copy of what you're sending? Oh, no, I didn't pay no attention to that. You should have made a carbon copy. Yeah, sure. That should be coming up.
